_about: Every place the mod touches the game. 'how' is the mechanism, 'game_data' what is read or written, 'proof' what shows it works.

rows.how: DllMain spawns a thread; wait for game window + fresh singleton scan before touching eldenring crate
rows.proof: log line 'boot ready' with player found

rows.how: register a per-frame CS task (CSTaskGroupIndex after physics) or poll from the boot thread at 120 Hz
CSChrActionRequestModule.new_action_presses.sp_move() (dodge/roll/sprint press) read each frame; no DirectInput hook needed

rows.proof: boost goes where the stick points

rows.how: physics.position += direction*step along the roll direction read 3 frames after the press, clamped by CSPhysWorld::cast_ray (filter 0x2000058) from chest height; chr_proxy_pos_update_requested=true
rows.proof: player covers boost_distance_m in boost_duration_s, no clipping into walls

rows.how: gravity_multiplier=0 and gravity_disabled=true while flying/gliding (restored on landing); fall_timer=0 and material.disable_fall_damage while flying and 1.5 s after
rows.proof: no fall death after glide ends

rows.how: write FP in both the character data module and PlayerGameData.current_fp; EN refills after en_regen_delay_s at en_regen_pct_per_s
rows.proof: FP bar drains on boost and refills after delay

rows.how: grant an existing invulnerability SpEffect during boost_iframe_s
rows.game_data: SpEffect id of vanilla roll i-frames (to find)
rows.proof: enemy hit during boost deals no damage

rows.how: PlayerGameData.archetype (0 Vagabond, 1 Warrior, 2 Hero) -> class row 3000+archetype -> frame; only when character_name is set and level > 0
hook ntdll NtCreateFile/NtOpenFile/NtDeleteFile/NtQuery*Attributes/NtSetInformationFile(rename) and redirect ER0000.sl2(.bak) to ER0000.mec(.bak); string patching alone was NOT enough
rows.proof: new file appears in the save folder; user's saves untouched

rows.how: regulation.bin rebuilt from the sheets by tools/build_regulation.py (protector hide flags and weight, class stats and loadouts, weapon clones, camera rows)
rows.proof: new weapons appear and fire in game

rows.how: FMG edits in menu/item msgbnd for class and item names
